# QuantixTools

> Free Islamic reference tools: a Zakat calculator and a searchable Halal food-additive checker. Calculations run in the visitor's browser. Content is informational and is not a fatwa or personal financial advice.

## Main tools

- [Zakat Calculator](https://quantixtools.com/zakat-calculator/): Estimate Zakat on cash, gold, silver, crypto, stocks, and business assets.
- [Halal E-Number Checker](https://quantixtools.com/halal-food-checker/): Search food additives and review their listed status, source, and notes.
- [Barcode Scanner](https://quantixtools.com/halal-food-checker/scanner/): Open the product barcode scanner.
